product.title: Bow Sports Capital — Creative Business Simulation
product.summary: A young creative chooses between a salaried job, a contract, and going independent.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students play a freelance creative choosing among a startup job, a six-month agency contract, or independence with a hire. Five chapters each lock in a strategy, show the consequence, and gate progress behind a quiz, ending in a ten-question final check.

facilitation.notes: Ships as one experience in two media: a browser build and a Google Apps Script build of the same five-chapter narrative. The Sheets build is facilitator-run and records evidence; the browser build does not.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Both builds are complete and the browser build is publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Five chapters of branching narrative with correctly applied economics and a gated knowledge check — deliberately failing produced 0/5 and blocked progress, so the gate is real.
knownBlockers: The strategic choices drive no tracked state. There is no meter, score or resource anywhere; a choice only selects which narrative text and which quiz questions come next, so nothing is at stake in choosing.
Begin Journey silently does nothing until a school email is entered, with no required-field indicator, on an otherwise unauthenticated public page.

curation.tierBasis: Correctly applied economics chapter by chapter, but no meter, score or resource exists, so the strategic choices only gate which quiz comes next.

provenance.evidence: 201-M2-ECON/index.html <title>Bow Sports Capital - Creative Business Simulation</title>. The 'apps script' file implements the same five-chapter freelance/agency narrative as a Sheets state machine.
openQuestions: The browser build asks for a school email but no network call was found, so where that email goes is unresolved.
